title: Simple copper pipes's delight
description: Water your rich soil farmlands (Farmer's Delight) using pipes (Simple Copper Pipes)!
body:
# Simple copper pipe's delight

Nah you can't eat pipes, but you can water your crops with them.

Water your rich soil farmlands with simple copper pipes !

This mod is intended to work with the **Homestead** modpack, if you want it to work with other minecraft / farmer's delight / simple copper pipes versions, make an issue in my GitHub repository
